1 Sep 2017, R/2017/172: The curtain airbag (one or both side) may not deploy in the event of a side impact because the pyrotechnic mix ratio in the ignitor could be incorrect.. Fix: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the serial number of the curtain airbag. Replace airbag if required. cars built 20 Sep 2016 to 30 Nov 2016 (610), listed as MEGANE.
4 Apr 2017, R/2017/117: The rear door child locks may deactivate when a door is slammed. There will be no warning that the child lock has gone from active to inactive. Fix: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the door child locks are to specification. If they are not they are to be replaced with ones that are to specification. cars built 20 May 2016 to 18 Jul 2016 (2,415), listed as MEGANE.
8 Apr 2014, R/2014/038: It is possible that the rear body shelf fixing may not be secured to the vehicle sufficiently. This may lead to the detachment of the shelf and place other road users at risk. Fix: Recall all affected vehicles and fit additional fixings. cars built 31 May 2010 to 14 Oct 2013 (3,842), listed as MEGANE.
8 Mar 2013, R/2013/034: The rear spoiler may detach at high speed due to high variance in temperature change aggressive car wash systems or use of racks as they may weaken the spoiler mouldings. Fix: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected for rebonding or reinforcement of the rear tailgate spoiler (depending on type of tailgate). cars built 1 Sep 2003 to 31 Oct 2009 (22,739), listed as MEGANE.
1 Oct 2012, R/2012/093: The injection computer requires reprogramming. If this is not carried out reduced braking assistance may be noticed Fix: Preventive operation: 1. Reprogramme the injection computer; 2. Reconfigure the UPC computer. cars (31), listed as MEGANE.

3 Nov 2017, R/2017/302: Due to a deviation in the production process certain suspension and steering fixings may not have been tightened to the correct torque. Fix: On affected vehicles check fixings as indicated by the manufacturer. Replace any damaged fixings and tighten all relevant fixings to correct torque. cars built 16 Aug 2017 to 20 Sep 2017 (488), listed as 208.
24 Apr 2017, R/2017/140: A possible nonconformity of an internal component of the starter motor relay could affect the control of the starter motor. This could adversely affect the starting operation and damage the starter motor due to overheating and in extreme cases there is a risk of fire. Fix: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the starter motor relay. cars built 15 May 2016 to 12 Oct 2016 (6,768), listed as 208.
3 Apr 2017, R/2017/120: The bonding of the tailgate spoiler may not conform to specification. This could lead to a lack of adhesion and detachment of the spoiler Fix: On affected vehicles replace the rear spoiler cars built 7 Jan 2017 to 18 Jan 2017 (8), listed as 208.
14 Oct 2016, R/2016/230: In the event of emergency braking or during an ESP regulation phase (e.g. avoiding manoeuvre) the hydraulic block may not prevent the locking of a wheel which could affect  control of the vehicle. Fix: On affected vehicles replace the braking system hydraulic block cars built 1 Apr 2016 to 6 Apr 2016 (600), listed as 208.
13 Mar 2015, R/2015/060: It is possible that the front subframe and suspension wishbones mounting bolts may not have been torqued to the correct specification.  This could result in the mounting bolt working loose and falling from the vehicle plus the possibility of the insecurity of the subframe or the front suspension wishbone. This can cause an issue with the handling or even loss of control of the vehicle. Fix: Recall all affected vehicles to check and retorque the front subframe and suspension wishbone mounting bolts. cars built 3 Dec 2014 to 3 Dec 2014 (2), listed as 208.
22 Jul 2014, R/2014/081: Front subframes on affected vehicles may show signs of damage to the left hand mounting point  caused during the manufacturing process. Over time this may affect durability and cause the mounting to fail. This can affect security of components attached to the subframe and may affect control of the vehicle. Fix: Prior to failure the driver should notice excessive noise from this area. As a safety measure affected vehicles should be checked and where necessary the subframe replaced. cars built 4 Jun 2014 to 11 Jun 2014 (14), listed as 208.
15 May 2014, R/2014/058: Affected vehicles may have struts with a non compliant internal component. This may prevent the struts from maintaining the tailgate in the open position. Fix: Non compliant struts are determined by using manufacturer test methods. If replacement is required both struts must be replaced. cars built 11 Mar 2014 to 13 Mar 2014 (125), listed as 208.
22 Apr 2014, R/2014/046: The front suspension wishbone mounting bolts might not have been manufactured to the correct specification potentially causing a risk of these parts breaking. Broken mounting bolts can be noticed by the driver through noises and poor directional control. Fix: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the front suspension wishbone mounting bolts. cars built 24 Sep 2013 to 26 Nov 2014 (5,502), listed as 208.
17 Dec 2012, R/2012/158: Some vehicles from the affected production batch may have an issue with the effectiveness of the ESP system caused by non-conformity with the ABS/ESP hydraulic block. Consequences: This non-conformity will not affect the operation of the ABS system or the efficiency of the brakes. It may affect the operation of the ESP system on the rare occasions that it is activated; the correction of the drive delivered to the road wheel(s) when the ESP is activated may not be accurate to how it is manufactured to respond. Fix: The hydraulic ABS/ESP block is to be replaced. cars built 19 Jul 2012 to 20 Jul 2012 (14), listed as 208.
12 Sep 2012, R/2012/100: During production it is possible the brake system may not have been bled correctly and some air may remain in the brake system. 16 Jul 2012, R/2012/080: On a small batch of vehicles the bonnet catch may not be correctly installed. If the bonnet is opened and then closed incorrectly it could result in the latch being insecure. Fix: Recall affected vehicles to check the bonnet catch. Where necessary the bonnet catch will be replaced. cars built 2 Mar 2012 to 2 Mar 2012 (1), listed as 208.

3 Jul 2025, R/2025/245: Vehicles may be affected by premature wearing of the camshaft drive chain leading to abnormal noise or to a breakage of the chain in the worst case. The malfunction is caused by PMIC noise induced falsely high temperature sensor readings which trigger the chip protection logic above a certain threshold and lead to performance limitation up to reboot or black screen. Fix: Over The Air software update or dealer software update cars built 1 Jul 2025 to 17 Dec 2025 (302), listed as EV6.

Fix: The vehicles identified require a software update for the Shifter Control Unit (SCU). cars built 17 Jul 2021 to 2 May 2022 (3,805), listed as EV6.

3 Jul 2026, R/2026/256: Affected vehicles may have a tyre class mismatch between the technical specification declared in the Certificate of Conformity and the actual vehicle configuration. Fix: Check the tyre class of all vehicle tyres and exchange all 4 for Class A+ tyres if necessary cars built 7 Mar 2025 to 16 Apr 2025 (261), listed as 3008 V3.
21 Apr 2026, R/2025/542: On certain Peugeot vehicles the Automatic Emergency Braking Assist  telltale fails to illuminate if the front camera is blocked. No AEB warning  telltale meaning no warning light appears in the instrument cluster. An  additional pop-up appears for around 10 seconds at each key on/key off  (Driving Assistance Sensor Blind: clean sensor see User Manual). The  Automatic Emergency Braking system is operating in a degraded mode but  remains functional due to radar support. Fix: To rectify this issue we will update the Vehicle System Management software cars built 28 Sep 2023 to 2 Jul 2024 (2,443), listed as 3008 V3.
29 Jan 2026, R/2026/045: Affected vehicles may have improperly tightened wheel nuts following a faulty rework. Fix: Check the torque of the wheel nuts on all for wheels and re-tighten if necessary. cars built 19 Nov 2024 to 13 Jun 2025 (3), listed as 3008.
25 Nov 2025, R/2025/522: On affected vehicles the front left and right control arm ball-joint bracket screws are at risk of fracture which could affect the vehicle's controllability. Fix: Inspect the marking on the left and right front ball-joint bracket and change if necessary. cars built 24 Jul 2023 to 28 Feb 2025 (13,330), listed as 3008 V3.
8 Sep 2025, R/2025/382: Affected vehicles may have a fault in the High Voltage Battery which could potentially lead to it overheating and in the worst case a battery or vehicle fire. Customers are advised to stop any plug-in charging and eSave charging until the vehicle is reworked. Fix: Update the battery management software or replace the High Voltage Battery if necessary. cars built 2 Jul 2019 to 12 Oct 2022 (934), listed as 3008 V2.
3 Jul 2025, R/2025/246: Vehicles may be affected by premature wearing of the camshaft drive chain leading to abnormal noise or to a breakage of the chain in the worst case. Fix: Update the software to improve oil pressure and reduce wear. Check the engine noise and replace the chain if required. If no problem found change the oil to one with higher viscosity and special anti-wear additives. cars built 11 Oct 2017 to 31 Jan 2023 (22,401), listed as 3008.
11 Feb 2025, R/2025/048: On affected vehicles front seat headrests are not to specification. Fix: Check the fixing notches of the front seat headrests and exchange them if necessary. cars built 23 Sep 2024 to 5 Nov 2024 (971), listed as 3008.
12 Dec 2024, R/2024/497: On affected vehicles the fixing bolts on the front left or right bracket on the lower control arm may break.  In the worst-case scenario 2 broken bolts could affect the controllability of the vehicle. Fix: Change the front left and right ball joint brackets. cars built 17 Jul 2023 to 29 Nov 2024 (13,416), listed as 3008.
24 Oct 2024, R/2024/423: On affected vehicles the cradle bracket is not according to specification.  In some cases this could lead to cracking of the bracket and structural integrity loss resulting in loss of vehicle control. Fix: Check the cradle bracket and rework if necessary. cars built 26 Aug 2024 to 3 Sep 2024 (203), listed as 3008.
21 Jul 2022, R/2022/228: A high voltage battery where there is a mismatch in the voltage of the individual cells. Fix: Replace the high voltage battery. cars built 8 Oct 2019 to 20 Nov 2019 (8), listed as 3008 V2.
21 Jul 2022, R/2022/227: A high voltage battery where there is a mismatch in the voltage of the individual cells. Fix: Replace the HV traction battery cars built 8 Oct 2019 to 20 Nov 2019 (4), listed as 3008 V2.
5 Mar 2021, R/2021/081: The welding of the individual components of the towbar might not meet the correct specification. Fix: Check the identity label and replace the tow bar if affected cars built 3 May 2016 to 1 Mar 2021 (61), listed as 3008 V2.
21 Jan 2021, R/2021/041: The welding of some components to the towbar assembly may not meet specification. Fix: The replacement of the towbar. cars built 10 Sep 2020 to 29 Dec 2020 (24), listed as 3008 V2.
20 Jan 2021, R/2020/326: The brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt. Fix: Update detection software inspect and if necessary replace vacuum pump and timing belt. cars built 17 Jun 2013 to 1 Apr 2017 (45,160), listed as 3008 V1, 3008 V2.
8 Dec 2020, R/2020/366: On affected vehicles the alignment of the electrodes may be out of specification on some cells of the traction batteries which may result in the release of toxic fumes or a thermal runaway. Fix: Replace the traction / drive battery. cars built 1 Oct 2019 to 23 Dec 2019 (3), listed as 3008 V2.
19 Aug 2020, R/2020/245: The vehicles may be affected by a defect in the urea injector which might block and lead to NOx emissions going out of the regulatory limits. Fix: Updating the ECU software to avoid the gradual blocking of the urea injector cars built 1 Oct 2019 to 17 Mar 2020 (5,125), listed as 3008.
9 Jul 2020, R/2020/207: There is a possibility that the internal corrosion protection of the front subframe is not durable enough. Fix: Replacing the front subframe assembly. cars built 23 Feb 2015 to 13 Mar 2015 (38), listed as 3008.
25 Feb 2020, R/2020/052: Certain rear suspension fixing bolts may not conform to specification which could cause them to break. Fix: Replace the affected bolts cars built 12 Oct 2019 to 15 Jan 2020 (78), listed as 3008.
29 Mar 2018, R/2018/089: Tightening of some towbar fixings may not be to correct specification. Fix: Checking and if necessary correcting the tightening torque of the fixings. cars built 15 Jun 2017 to 15 Jan 2018 (9), listed as 3008.
10 Oct 2017, R/2017/270: The positioning of the starter supply terminal may be incorrect. This may allow it to foul other components and cause a short circuit. Fix: On affected vehicles check the positioning of the terminaL. Correct it if necessary and add additional protection. cars built 5 Apr 2016 to 17 Jul 2017 (1,703), listed as 3008.
6 Jul 2017, R/2017/215: The positioning of the starter motor supply terminal may not conform to specification. Contact with a neighbouring component could cause a short circuit. Fix: On affected vehicles check the position of the terminal and where necessary reposition. Replace damaged components if necessary. cars built 2 Oct 2013 to 4 Apr 2017 (7,394), listed as 3008.
24 Apr 2017, R/2017/140: A possible nonconformity of an internal component of the starter motor relay could affect the control of the starter motor. This could adversely affect the starting operation and damage the starter motor due to overheating and in extreme cases there is a risk of fire. Fix: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the starter motor relay. cars built 15 May 2016 to 12 Oct 2016 (6,768), listed as 3008.
1 Apr 2014, R/2014/035: Affected vehicles may present friction wear on the driver's seat wiring harness. Potentially causing an electrical malfunction and in worst case scenario cause the unwanted triggering of the driver's seat air bag. Fix: The remedial operation consists of reinforcing and clamping the driver's seat harness. cars built 5 Nov 2012 to 4 Oct 2013 (100), listed as 3008.
4 Mar 2013, R/2013/026: On a very limited number of vehicles it is necessary to check the presence of specific spot welds on the vehicle body shell.  Should it be identified that one of the welds has been missed in production the vehicle cannot be repaired. In the long term and in very rare cases body noises and squeaking could appear. Fix: In the rare case that the vehicle does not comply the vehicle will be removed from the road and the customer will be provided with a replacement vehicle. cars built 7 Nov 2012 to 21 Nov 2012 (19), listed as 3008.
28 Jan 2013, R/2013/010: The tightening torque of the rear brake calliper mounting bolts could be incorrect.  This incorrect tightening torque may in very rare cases eventually lead to the slackening of the bolt and an increase in noise during braking Fix: Replace the bolts and tighten to the correct  torque cars built 9 Oct 2012 to 9 Oct 2012 (2), listed as 3008.

Fix: Check and replace affected battery modules. cars built 5 Sep 2023 to 5 Sep 2023 (19), listed as ID BUZZ.

14 Nov 2025, R/2025/508: On affected vehicles an important connection in the seat belt buckle may not have been produced correctly during the assembly process. Fix: The belt buckles on both front seats (left and right) must be replaced. cars built 24 Mar 2025 to 2 Apr 2025 (4), listed as A6.
24 Oct 2025, R/2025/463: On affected vehicles there may be defective battery modules which may result in a fire hazard when charging the high-voltage battery. Fix: Update the software of the high-voltage battery to improve the self-diagnosis capabilities.  Vehicle owners are advised to not charge the high-voltage battery using external charging sources and also not use the e-tron modes “Battery charge” and “Battery hold” until the update is applied. cars built 26 Feb 2021 to 10 Jun 2024 (1,458), listed as A6.
8 Aug 2025, R/2025/387: Urgent Safety Warning – Do Not Drive Your Vehicle Affected vehicles were originally allocated to or used for an extended period of time in a region with a climate zone considered to as HIGH RISK. Certain front airbags contain an ageing inflator propellant that may explode when deployed due to long-term exposure to heat and humidity. If the airbag inflator explodes metal fragments may be ejected causing life-threatening or fatal injuries to anyone in the vehicle. Fix: Affected airbags will be be replaced. You can contact Audi's dedicated Takata Stop Drive helpline at 0113 526 9646 (MONDAY to FRIDAY 9:00AM to 5:00PM. cars built 27 Jul 2004 to 10 Dec 2010 (74), listed as A6.
9 Dec 2024, R/2024/495: On affected vehicles battery modules may become defective over the course of the vehicle’s service life. This may result in a fire hazard when charging the high-voltage battery with the associated risk of severe or fatal injuries to people inside and/or outside the vehicle as well as significant material damage. To minimise this risk do not charge the high-voltage battery using an external charging source. In addition do not use the e-tron modes “Battery charge” and “Battery hold” (refer to Owner’s Manual) until further notice. Fix: Replace the defective modules. Further software fix being developed to improve monitoring. cars built 19 Mar 2021 to 17 Oct 2022 (596), listed as A6.
4 Apr 2024, R/2024/158: On affected vehicles the passenger airbag may in extremely rare cases be overloaded and even burst when the passenger airbag is triggered. If this were to happen small metal parts could become dislodged from the housing and potentially cause life-threatening injury to a vehicle occupant. Fix: For safety reasons it is necessary to check the passenger airbag and if required to replace the airbag module. cars built 10 Mar 2004 to 30 Aug 2011 (74,226), listed as A6.
27 Oct 2023, R/2023/317: On certain vehicles an incorrect bracket for the side airbag was fitted in the left front seat. Fix: Replace the side airbag and bracket. cars built 4 Jul 2023 to 4 Jul 2023 (5), listed as A6.
1 Feb 2023, R/2023/053: If a front airbag is deployed it is possible that the gas generator housing in which the propellant is generated may burst on vehicles manufactured within a limited period. Fix: As a precautionary safety measure it is necessary to replace the airbag unit on the passenger side. cars built 18 May 2004 to 22 Feb 2010 (13), listed as A6.
14 Feb 2022, R/2022/036: Following a previous campaign the toe and/or camber values on the rear axle may in certain circumstances incorrectly be changed without this being noticed. Fix: The wheel alignment must be checked and if necessary the suspension must be serviced on the affected vehicles. cars built 7 Nov 2019 to 20 Feb 2021 (5,327), listed as A6.
22 Sep 2021, R/2021/330: On vehicles with 3-spoke steering wheel manufactured within a specific period the function of the driver airbag may be restricted due to its age. Fix: The gas generator in the driver airbag must be replaced on the affected vehicles. cars built 10 Jan 2000 to 13 Aug 2001 (9,536), listed as A6.
22 Sep 2021, R/2021/234: On vehicles with TAKATA driver airbag and NADI gas generator manufactured within a specific period it is possible that the function of the driver airbag may be restricted due to its age. Fix: The driver airbag unit must be checked on the vehicles affected and the gas generator must be replaced if necessary cars built 14 Apr 1997 to 23 Dec 1999 (57,169), listed as A6.
25 Jun 2021, R/2021/236: One or more nuts which do not meet the specifications may have been fitted on the rear axle suspension links. Fix: The affected nuts on the rear axle will be replaced on affected vehicles. cars built 7 Nov 2019 to 18 Feb 2021 (10,089), listed as A6.
26 Mar 2021, R/2021/117: In the event of an accident requiring the vehicle�s front passenger airbag  to be activated the airbag might not inflate fully. Fix: The dash panel must be checked on the affected vehicles and repaired or replaced if required cars built 7 Feb 2018 to 14 Dec 2020 (1,298), listed as A6.
8 Dec 2020, R/2020/372: Faulty crash sensors for airbag / restraint systems may have been fitted in both of the front doors. Fix: The crash sensors for the side airbags (front) must be checked on the vehicles affected and replaced if necessary. cars built 1 Jul 2020 to 15 Sep 2020 (31), listed as A6.
2 Oct 2020, R/2020/265: It is possible that moisture may enter the belt-driven starter-alternator. Fix: The starter-alternator must be replaced on the affected vehicles. cars built 10 Aug 2018 to 11 Mar 2020 (11,936), listed as A6.
30 Jun 2020, R/2020/138: It is possible that moisture may enter the belt-driven starter-alternator. Fix: The starter-alternator must be replaced on the affected vehicles. cars built 1 Jun 2017 to 31 Mar 2020 (34,982), listed as A6.
3 Jun 2019, R/2019/175: Hinged towing bracket on which the locking mechanism in the hinge module could be faulty. Fix: The hinge module for the towing bracket must be checked and replaced if required. cars built 2 Dec 2015 to 17 Dec 2018 (135), listed as A6.
22 Feb 2019, R/2019/060: The auxiliary heater element connection in the air conditioner may fail. Fix: Check the auxiliary heater connector and replace the element if required. cars built 8 Jul 2014 to 31 Oct 2014 (4,907), listed as A6.
17 Dec 2018, R/2018/363: There is a possibility that the glass bonding on the panoramic sunroof is not bonded correctly. Fix: Replace the affected glass section with new bonding. cars built 16 Jul 2018 to 10 Oct 2018 (59), listed as A6.
20 Feb 2017, R/2017/078: Due to an error in the manufacturing process the air bag and/or seat belt pretensioner may not trigger in the event of a collision Fix: On affected vehicles replace air bag  assembly and seta belt pretensioner where necessary. cars built 1 May 2016 to 31 Oct 2016 (2,622), listed as A6.

18 Mar 2026, R/2026/111: Certain affected vehicles may not have the remedy for Compliance Recall 24C12 installed correctly Fix: Dealers will update Audio Front Control Module (ACM) software to the latest level available. cars built 11 Apr 2024 to 30 Apr 2024 (3), listed as FOCUS.
13 Feb 2026, R/2026/059: On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 20C22 may not have been delivered properly and the Telematics Control Unit (TCU) in these vehicles may disconnect from Ford’s Service Delivery Network and become unresponsive. Fix: Update the TCU software and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly. cars built 31 Jul 2018 to 19 Oct 2019 (49), listed as FOCUS. Follows an earlier recall that did not hold.
24 Sep 2025, R/2025/361: On affected vehicles there is a potential software issue causing the rear-view camera not to function as intended. Fix: Update the Accessory Protocol Interface Module (APIM) software to the latest level. cars built 1 Dec 2021 to 4 Apr 2024 (2,991), listed as FOCUS.
8 Sep 2025, R/2025/359: On affected vehicles a software problem may result in issues with the rear-view camera that reduce the driver’s view or with it remaining on after a reversing event. Fix: Update the vehicle software to the latest level. cars built 18 Sep 2018 to 29 Nov 2021 (8), listed as FOCUS.
18 Jul 2024, R/2024/294: While monitoring vehicles in operation we have identified a number of Focus vehicles where the passenger belt minder chime is not activated when the vehicle goes over 15 mph. Regulatory requirements mandate that an audible chime must activate when the first-row passenger seatbelt is unfastened and the vehicle speed exceeds 15 mph. Fix: Update the instrument panel cluster IPC configuration. cars built 20 Dec 2023 to 13 Jun 2024 (1,311), listed as FOCUS.
18 Jun 2024, R/2024/244: A number of Focus vehicles have been identified where the warning chimes may not be operating as intended. The chimes may not be audible when the driver is not holding the steering wheel for longer than 30 seconds while using Lane Centering Assist which does not meet ECE regulations. Fix: Updating software in control unit. cars built 4 Apr 2023 to 2 May 2024 (85), listed as FOCUS.
2 Aug 2023, R/2023/237: On affected vehicles the Lighting Driver Module software may be incorrectly configured which could potentially cause the adaptive headlamps to not work as intended. Fix: Software update and/or headlamp adjustment in order to restore feature functionality. cars built 26 May 2023 to 14 Jun 2023 (96), listed as FOCUS.
21 Jul 2023, R/2023/204: On certain vehicles tape used to protect the end of the ground connection wiring harness of the 48V battery may have become trapped beneath the nut securing the wiring harness. Fix: Inspect the ground connection harness. If required the tape on end of the connector will be reapplied and the nut tightened to the specified torque. cars built 26 May 2023 to 26 May 2023 (3), listed as FOCUS.
21 Jun 2023, R/2023/186: Certain vehicles may be fitted with a seatbelt that does not meet the high specification expected by Ford due to a rivet that is holding the buckle not being fully secured. Fix: Dealers will inspect all vehicles and if found necessary will replace the part that is not meeting specification. cars built 24 Mar 2023 to 17 May 2023 (2,196), listed as FOCUS.
12 Aug 2022, R/2022/248: A possibility that vehicles could have a front suspension knuckle that was incorrectly manufactured. Fix: Inspect and if necessary replace the affected components. cars built 9 Jun 2022 to 6 Jul 2022 (179), listed as FOCUS.
29 Jul 2022, R/2022/239: It may be possible that the eCall feature will stop functioning due to a malfunction. Fix: The Telecommunication Module will need to be replaced cars built 18 Mar 2022 to 27 Jul 2022 (9,388), listed as FOCUS.
1 Jul 2022, R/2022/176: The Garnish Panel from the Panorama roof may detach.� Fix: Test the adhesion of the panel bonding material and if necessary replace the panel.� cars built 16 Sep 2021 to 21 Sep 2021 (12), listed as FOCUS.
17 Mar 2022, R/2022/051: The nuts on the 48V battery poles may not be torqued to specification. Fix: Remove both positive and negative poll nuts and inspect the wiring for signs of damage. Any damaged wiring will be replaced. Both nuts will be refitted and torqued to specification. cars built 1 Sep 2021 to 25 Jan 2022 (17), listed as FOCUS.
22 Sep 2021, R/2021/285: The screw which secures the ground cable of the 48v battery may not be fully secured. Fix: Replace the ground cable bolt on all vehicles and torque to specification cars built 13 Aug 2020 to 19 Jan 2021 (11), listed as FOCUS.
21 May 2021, R/2021/177: Vehicles may have an issue with the current software that controls the functionality of the eCall system. Fix: Carry out a software update. cars built 15 Jul 2019 to 12 Feb 2021 (100), listed as FOCUS.
25 Jan 2021, R/2021/021: A nut securing the mHEV battery connection may not be torqued to specification. Fix: Remove the nut and inspect the wiring for signs of damage. Any damaged wiring will be replaced. A new nut will be fitted and torqued to specification in all circumstances. cars built 25 Jun 2020 to 30 Nov 2020 (13), listed as FOCUS.
24 Jan 2020, R/2019/421: A defect on the Power Distribution Box (PDB) pins may potentially cause an intermittent poor connection on a number of terminals. Fix: Inspect for potential damage If present replace Power Distribution Box and interfacing wiring loom pins cars built 14 Oct 2019 to 16 Oct 2019 (4,538), listed as FOCUS.
5 Nov 2019, R/2019/334: Seat belt anchors and seat bolts may not be secured as per specification Fix: Check tighten and torque all identified bolts to specification cars built 7 May 2019 to 30 Sep 2019 (11), listed as FOCUS.
6 Mar 2019, R/2019/085: Bolts fixing the front suspension to the vehicle may not be tightened to the correct torque. Fix: The front suspension bolts must be inspected and set to the correct torque. cars built 22 Sep 2018 to 10 Nov 2018 (22), listed as FOCUS.
12 Feb 2019, R/2019/045: Potential for the rear doors to open when the rear windows are lowered. Fix: Ensure the door release cable is in the correct position and adjusted if necessary. cars built 12 Mar 2018 to 21 Jan 2019 (1,729), listed as FOCUS.
21 Dec 2018, R/2018/375: A brake pedal hinge bolt which does not meet specification. Fix: Check torque of brake pedal hinge bolt. If the vehicle fails the test replace the brake pedal box cars built 19 Oct 2018 to 8 Dec 2018 (5,336), listed as FOCUS.
30 Nov 2018, R/2018/261: Rear door latch child lock may not function correctly. Fix: Check child locks for correct activation and replace if necessary. cars built 16 Apr 2018 to 2 Aug 2018 (3,021), listed as FOCUS.
19 Mar 2018, R/2018/011: A small batch of alloy wheels may have a casting defect that may initiate a fatigue crack and result in wheel failure. Fix: Check wheels on affected vehicles for a specific batch code. Replace those wheels which have the identified batch code. cars built 26 Sep 2016 to 10 Oct 2016 (80), listed as FOCUS.
4 Sep 2017, R/2017/241: The airbag initiator may be defective and may prevent the side airbag(s) and/or knee airbag deploying in the event of an accident. In a collision the airbags not deploying could put the occupants at further risk. Fix: Recall the 1943 vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the side and knee protection airbags complete with initiators. cars built 18 Jul 2016 to 28 Nov 2016 (1,943), listed as FOCUS.
9 Jul 2014, R/2014/063: Engineering investigations have identified that vehicles operated in countries which have high road salt usage during winter months may experience an increased risk of corrosion build up. In extreme cases the corrosion can propagate into the electronic circuits and result in overheating. In rare cases the overheating may be sufficient to ignite the module and surrounding wiring and components. Fix: A supplemental wiring loom that removes the power supply to the fan control module when the ignition is switched off is required to be fitted to affected vehicles. An additional water shield must also be fitted to protect the module against water entry and corrosion build up. cars built 1 Jun 2006 to 10 Apr 2007 (34,119), listed as FOCUS.

14 Nov 2025, R/2025/508: On affected vehicles an important connection in the seat belt buckle may not have been produced correctly during the assembly process. Fix: The belt buckles on both front seats (left and right) must be replaced. cars built 24 Mar 2025 to 2 Apr 2025 (4), listed as A6.
24 Oct 2025, R/2025/463: On affected vehicles there may be defective battery modules which may result in a fire hazard when charging the high-voltage battery. Fix: Update the software of the high-voltage battery to improve the self-diagnosis capabilities.  Vehicle owners are advised to not charge the high-voltage battery using external charging sources and also not use the e-tron modes “Battery charge” and “Battery hold” until the update is applied. cars built 26 Feb 2021 to 10 Jun 2024 (1,458), listed as A6.
8 Aug 2025, R/2025/387: Urgent Safety Warning – Do Not Drive Your Vehicle Affected vehicles were originally allocated to or used for an extended period of time in a region with a climate zone considered to as HIGH RISK. Certain front airbags contain an ageing inflator propellant that may explode when deployed due to long-term exposure to heat and humidity. If the airbag inflator explodes metal fragments may be ejected causing life-threatening or fatal injuries to anyone in the vehicle. Fix: Affected airbags will be be replaced. You can contact Audi's dedicated Takata Stop Drive helpline at 0113 526 9646 (MONDAY to FRIDAY 9:00AM to 5:00PM. cars built 27 Jul 2004 to 10 Dec 2010 (74), listed as A6.
9 Dec 2024, R/2024/495: On affected vehicles battery modules may become defective over the course of the vehicle’s service life. This may result in a fire hazard when charging the high-voltage battery with the associated risk of severe or fatal injuries to people inside and/or outside the vehicle as well as significant material damage. To minimise this risk do not charge the high-voltage battery using an external charging source. In addition do not use the e-tron modes “Battery charge” and “Battery hold” (refer to Owner’s Manual) until further notice. Fix: Replace the defective modules. Further software fix being developed to improve monitoring. cars built 19 Mar 2021 to 17 Oct 2022 (596), listed as A6.
4 Apr 2024, R/2024/158: On affected vehicles the passenger airbag may in extremely rare cases be overloaded and even burst when the passenger airbag is triggered. If this were to happen small metal parts could become dislodged from the housing and potentially cause life-threatening injury to a vehicle occupant. Fix: For safety reasons it is necessary to check the passenger airbag and if required to replace the airbag module. cars built 10 Mar 2004 to 30 Aug 2011 (74,226), listed as A6.
27 Oct 2023, R/2023/317: On certain vehicles an incorrect bracket for the side airbag was fitted in the left front seat. Fix: Replace the side airbag and bracket. cars built 4 Jul 2023 to 4 Jul 2023 (5), listed as A6.
1 Feb 2023, R/2023/053: If a front airbag is deployed it is possible that the gas generator housing in which the propellant is generated may burst on vehicles manufactured within a limited period. Fix: As a precautionary safety measure it is necessary to replace the airbag unit on the passenger side. cars built 18 May 2004 to 22 Feb 2010 (13), listed as A6.
14 Feb 2022, R/2022/036: Following a previous campaign the toe and/or camber values on the rear axle may in certain circumstances incorrectly be changed without this being noticed. Fix: The wheel alignment must be checked and if necessary the suspension must be serviced on the affected vehicles. cars built 7 Nov 2019 to 20 Feb 2021 (5,327), listed as A6.
22 Sep 2021, R/2021/330: On vehicles with 3-spoke steering wheel manufactured within a specific period the function of the driver airbag may be restricted due to its age. Fix: The gas generator in the driver airbag must be replaced on the affected vehicles. cars built 10 Jan 2000 to 13 Aug 2001 (9,536), listed as A6.
22 Sep 2021, R/2021/234: On vehicles with TAKATA driver airbag and NADI gas generator manufactured within a specific period it is possible that the function of the driver airbag may be restricted due to its age. Fix: The driver airbag unit must be checked on the vehicles affected and the gas generator must be replaced if necessary cars built 14 Apr 1997 to 23 Dec 1999 (57,169), listed as A6.
25 Jun 2021, R/2021/236: One or more nuts which do not meet the specifications may have been fitted on the rear axle suspension links. Fix: The affected nuts on the rear axle will be replaced on affected vehicles. cars built 7 Nov 2019 to 18 Feb 2021 (10,089), listed as A6.
26 Mar 2021, R/2021/117: In the event of an accident requiring the vehicle�s front passenger airbag  to be activated the airbag might not inflate fully. Fix: The dash panel must be checked on the affected vehicles and repaired or replaced if required cars built 7 Feb 2018 to 14 Dec 2020 (1,298), listed as A6.
8 Dec 2020, R/2020/372: Faulty crash sensors for airbag / restraint systems may have been fitted in both of the front doors. Fix: The crash sensors for the side airbags (front) must be checked on the vehicles affected and replaced if necessary. cars built 1 Jul 2020 to 15 Sep 2020 (31), listed as A6.
2 Oct 2020, R/2020/265: It is possible that moisture may enter the belt-driven starter-alternator. Fix: The starter-alternator must be replaced on the affected vehicles. cars built 10 Aug 2018 to 11 Mar 2020 (11,936), listed as A6.
30 Jun 2020, R/2020/138: It is possible that moisture may enter the belt-driven starter-alternator. Fix: The starter-alternator must be replaced on the affected vehicles. cars built 1 Jun 2017 to 31 Mar 2020 (34,982), listed as A6.
3 Jun 2019, R/2019/175: Hinged towing bracket on which the locking mechanism in the hinge module could be faulty. Fix: The hinge module for the towing bracket must be checked and replaced if required. cars built 2 Dec 2015 to 17 Dec 2018 (135), listed as A6.
22 Feb 2019, R/2019/060: The auxiliary heater element connection in the air conditioner may fail. Fix: Check the auxiliary heater connector and replace the element if required. cars built 8 Jul 2014 to 31 Oct 2014 (4,907), listed as A6.
17 Dec 2018, R/2018/363: There is a possibility that the glass bonding on the panoramic sunroof is not bonded correctly. Fix: Replace the affected glass section with new bonding. cars built 16 Jul 2018 to 10 Oct 2018 (59), listed as A6.
20 Feb 2017, R/2017/078: Due to an error in the manufacturing process the air bag and/or seat belt pretensioner may not trigger in the event of a collision Fix: On affected vehicles replace air bag  assembly and seta belt pretensioner where necessary. cars built 1 May 2016 to 31 Oct 2016 (2,622), listed as A6.

24 Oct 2025, R/2025/463: On affected vehicles there may be defective battery modules which may result in a fire hazard when charging the high-voltage battery. Fix: Update the software of the high-voltage battery to improve the self-diagnosis capabilities.  Vehicle owners are advised to not charge the high-voltage battery using external charging sources and also not use the e-tron modes “Battery charge” and “Battery hold” until the update is applied. cars built 26 Feb 2021 to 10 Jun 2024 (1,458), listed as A6.
8 Aug 2025, R/2025/387: Urgent Safety Warning – Do Not Drive Your Vehicle Affected vehicles were originally allocated to or used for an extended period of time in a region with a climate zone considered to as HIGH RISK. Certain front airbags contain an ageing inflator propellant that may explode when deployed due to long-term exposure to heat and humidity. If the airbag inflator explodes metal fragments may be ejected causing life-threatening or fatal injuries to anyone in the vehicle. Fix: Affected airbags will be be replaced. You can contact Audi's dedicated Takata Stop Drive helpline at 0113 526 9646 (MONDAY to FRIDAY 9:00AM to 5:00PM. cars built 27 Jul 2004 to 10 Dec 2010 (74), listed as A6.
9 Dec 2024, R/2024/495: On affected vehicles battery modules may become defective over the course of the vehicle’s service life. This may result in a fire hazard when charging the high-voltage battery with the associated risk of severe or fatal injuries to people inside and/or outside the vehicle as well as significant material damage. To minimise this risk do not charge the high-voltage battery using an external charging source. In addition do not use the e-tron modes “Battery charge” and “Battery hold” (refer to Owner’s Manual) until further notice. Fix: Replace the defective modules. Further software fix being developed to improve monitoring. cars built 19 Mar 2021 to 17 Oct 2022 (596), listed as A6.

Fix: For safety reasons it is necessary to check the passenger airbag and if required to replace the airbag module. cars built 10 Mar 2004 to 30 Aug 2011 (74,226), listed as A6.

25 Jun 2021, R/2021/236: One or more nuts which do not meet the specifications may have been fitted on the rear axle suspension links. Fix: The affected nuts on the rear axle will be replaced on affected vehicles. cars built 7 Nov 2019 to 18 Feb 2021 (10,089), listed as A6.

8 Dec 2020, R/2020/372: Faulty crash sensors for airbag / restraint systems may have been fitted in both of the front doors. 2 Oct 2020, R/2020/265: It is possible that moisture may enter the belt-driven starter-alternator. Fix: The starter-alternator must be replaced on the affected vehicles. cars built 10 Aug 2018 to 11 Mar 2020 (11,936), listed as A6.
30 Jun 2020, R/2020/138: It is possible that moisture may enter the belt-driven starter-alternator. Fix: The starter-alternator must be replaced on the affected vehicles. cars built 1 Jun 2017 to 31 Mar 2020 (34,982), listed as A6.
3 Jun 2019, R/2019/175: Hinged towing bracket on which the locking mechanism in the hinge module could be faulty. Fix: The hinge module for the towing bracket must be checked and replaced if required. cars built 2 Dec 2015 to 17 Dec 2018 (135), listed as A6.
22 Feb 2019, R/2019/060: The auxiliary heater element connection in the air conditioner may fail. Fix: Check the auxiliary heater connector and replace the element if required. cars built 8 Jul 2014 to 31 Oct 2014 (4,907), listed as A6.
17 Dec 2018, R/2018/363: There is a possibility that the glass bonding on the panoramic sunroof is not bonded correctly. Fix: Replace the affected glass section with new bonding. cars built 16 Jul 2018 to 10 Oct 2018 (59), listed as A6.

If this occurs the shift range will be changed from Park to Drive or Reverse and the brakes will be released without any finger operation on the smartphone resulting in the vehicle creeping forward or backward which could increase the risk of a crash. Fix: Reprogram the Clearance Sonar Electronic Control Unit (ECU) and Brake Electronic Control Unit (ECU) with modified software. cars built 23 Sep 2023 to 8 Dec 2023 (685), listed as C-HR.
18 Apr 2022, R/2022/055: The initialization of the radar sensor may not have been completed correctly. Fix: Inspect the radar sensor and if necessary properly initialize the radar sensor. cars built 20 Mar 2020 to 26 Jul 2021 (42,554), listed as C-HR. Follows an earlier recall that did not hold.
14 Dec 2020, R/2020/337: A possibility that a bolt of the brake pedal bracket may not have been torqued correctly. Fix: Tighten the bolt of the brake pedal bracket to the appropriate torque. cars built 10 Jun 2019 to 29 May 2020 (9,751), listed as C-HR.
4 Nov 2019, R/2019/333: Incorrectly installed covers could prevent the seat-mounted side air bag from deploying properly. Fix: Inspect the covers installed on the front seats and replace any incorrectly installed covers cars built 28 Sep 2016 to 30 May 2019 (3,887), listed as C-HR.
29 Oct 2018, R/2018/292: Rear axle bearing bolts may not have been tightened sufficiently during the manufacturing process. Fix: Inspect and replace the involved parts if necessary. cars built 18 Jun 2018 to 28 Aug 2018 (3,297), listed as C-HR.

14 Mar 2025, R/2025/104: On affected vehicles operating with a software release prior to 2023.38.4 an overvoltage breakdown in the steering rack may overstress motor drive components on the printed circuit board. If the overstress condition occurs while the vehicle is driving steering assistance will not be affected and a visual alert will illuminate. Once the vehicle speed comes to a standstill a loss of steering assistance may occur and loss of steering assistance will persist when the vehicle is driven again. Manual steering without steering assistance remains available to the driver. Fix: Install modified software via an Over the Air (OTA) wireless update. cars built 21 Jan 2022 to 26 Aug 2023 (30,864), listed as MODEL 3.
31 Dec 2024, R/2025/002: On affected vehicles upon detection of a malfunction with the tyre pressure monitoring system (TPMS) the TPMS tell tale does not persist between drive cycles where the vehicle is off or asleep between the drive cycles. 24 Dec 2021, R/2022/007: The curtain side airbags may not deploy correctly. Fix: Inspect for proper alignment and orientation of the left- and right-curtain side airbag. Re-align as necessary. cars built 20 Sep 2020 to 30 Dec 2020 (1), listed as MODEL 3.
